correctness.rationale: Exact 2x2 matrices have unit determinant and trace 2-h^2 in (-2,2), so each has bounded powers. The Gram average equals (1+h^6/32) times the identity, yielding an exact conditional expectation for every state and every step. For biased mixing the symmetric covariance map has det(I-T)=-h^8 p(1-p)(8-h^2)^2/128<0 and preserves the PSD cone, proving its spectral radius exceeds one. Alternating product trace 2-4h^2+h^4-h^6/16 crosses -2 at sqrt(5)-1, with nonzero off-diagonal Jordan witness. All critical identities were independently recalculated symbolically and 1302 finite rational assertions passed; finite experiments alone are not proofs.

value.rationale: Long-time near energy conservation is a defining motivation for symplectic geometric integrators. The exact sixth-order per-step mean-energy inflation when randomly selecting between two individually stable, second-order symplectic Verlet methods is a meaningful caution about stochastic composition. The exact fifth-order physical-time horizon and contrasting, sharp deterministic alternation threshold distinguish a structural mechanism, not a routine numerical benchmark or isolated sample.
